note: bandung: Bandung Raya is quiet for business events in this window. Most 2026 Bandung UMKM/export/franchise/property events (Trademark Market, IFBC Bandung, WIITEX, Pekan Kerajinan Jabar, IndoBuildTech Bandung, HRN 2026 festival 6-8 Nov, BLOOM Hijabfest 5-8 Nov) are already past. No HIPMI/KADIN/TDA/IWAPI/Dinas KUKM/BI Jabar public event for 14 Nov-14 Dec 2026 was found online; these are often announced only on Instagram/WhatsApp, so a manual check of their accounts is worth doing. · jabodetabek: Jabodetabek is thin for open SME events in this window: IFBC, FLEI, IFRA, TEI, KKI, Inacraft, JEC (TDA), Danantara Housing Expo and Harpropnas all ran earlier in 2026. IDECEXPO (26–28 Nov, NICE PIK 2) shows POSTPONED on its ticket page, so it was dropped. No December 2026 Holding UMKM Expo (Smesco) has been announced yet; last year's ran 22–24 Dec. · jabar: No qualifying major expo or business matching found in Other West Java (Cirebon, Karawang, Purwakarta, Sukabumi, Tasikmalaya, Garut, Subang, Cianjur, Kuningan, Majalengka) for 14 Nov - 14 Dec 2026. This year's regional business events already took place: Trikarsa Fest BI Cirebon (14-17 Aug), Pertamina SMEXPO Cirebon (23-25 Oct), Priangan Bamboo Fest Tasikmalaya (to 18 Oct), Festival Kuliner & Kriya Garut (24 Oct), Motekar Preneur Karawang (5-12 Sep), Sukabumi Expo (Sep). The only events in the window are cultural or tourism festivals (Cirebon Mask Festival 15-16 Nov, Festival Pesisiran Cirebon 14 Nov), so they are out of scope. · online: Online was thin for this window. Almost every 2026 online program found (Kemendag/ukmindonesia.id webinars, LPEI CPNE, ECP, ASIK, KADIN, TDA x Accurate, IKPI PP 20/2026, TERC FEB UI, Gapai Pasar Global AI) is already past or closed. Kemendag's routine online business matching is limited to registered exporters on InaExport, so it was dropped. Passive one-way classes (Kampus UMKM Shopee online, paid funnel webinars about digital products) were also dropped.

events.name: Plastics & Rubber Indonesia 2026 (37th International Plastics & Rubber Machinery, Processing & Materials Exhibition)
events.description: Annual B2B exhibition covering the plastics and rubber supply chain: machinery, processing, raw materials, moulds and recycling. Co-located with Plastic Material & Chemical and Plastic Recycling Indonesia, plus PlasPak and Mould & Die.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.organizer: PT Pamerindo Indonesia (Informa Markets), with Messe Düsseldorf Asia
events.audience: Trade visitors from the plastics and rubber industry
events.crowd: Plastic product manufacturers, packaging makers, distributors and plastics traders. Some aggregators claim 650+ exhibitors and ~20,000 visitors (unconfirmed).
events.speakers: Exhibitor count not published on the official site (counter shows a placeholder)
events.price: Not stated (online visitor pre-registration on the official site)
events.contact: Farah Alkatiri (Pamerindo) +62 21 2525 320; WhatsApp hotline on the official site
events.why: Best fit with your proof points: Nota Toko was built for a plastics and baking-supplies shop, so you can talk to plastics distributors and traders about invoicing, stock and nota from real experience. The halls are full of owners and sales directors, and almost nobody there builds software for them.
events.verified_note: Dates, venue, hours and organizer confirmed on plasticsandrubberindonesia.com (official: 17–20 Nov; several aggregators wrongly list 18–21 Nov). Visitor price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: Owners and managers of plastics converters, packaging makers and plastics distributors/traders, plus machinery and resin suppliers. Their daily pain points are stock of many SKUs (sizes and thicknesses), price lists that change with resin prices, handwritten nota and invoices, chasing receivables from resellers, and WhatsApp orders that get lost.
icebreakers: Bapak/Ibu di sini lebih banyak cari mesin baru atau cari supplier bahan baku?
Saya pernah bantu toko plastik dan bahan kue di Bandung bikin aplikasi kasir dan nota. Ternyata ribet juga ya ukuran dan jenis plastiknya banyak sekali. Di tempat Bapak/Ibu gimana?
Harga biji plastik lagi naik-turun begini, biasanya update daftar harga ke reseller gimana, Pak/Bu?

cost: Sekarang stok dan nota masih dicatat manual, pakai Excel, atau sudah pakai sistem?
Berapa sering ada selisih stok atau salah hitung harga waktu tutup buku?
Admin di kantor habis waktu paling banyak untuk apa: rekap order WA, bikin invoice, atau nagih piutang?
revenue: Pelanggan baru biasanya datang dari mana: reseller, marketplace, atau dari mulut ke mulut?
Reseller atau toko langganan bisa lihat katalog dan harga terbaru sendiri, atau harus tanya dulu lewat WA?
Ada rencana jual ke pabrik atau buyer luar kota yang lebih besar? Biasanya mereka minta apa dulu?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer yang bikin aplikasi kasir, nota, dan stok untuk usaha. Salah satunya Nota Toko, yang dipakai toko plastik dan bahan kue di Bandung. Saya juga bikin otomatisasi WhatsApp supaya order dan tagihan tidak tercecer.
prep.solution: Aplikasi stok, nota, dan invoice yang disesuaikan dengan SKU plastik Bapak/Ibu, plus katalog harga online dan pengingat tagihan otomatis lewat WhatsApp untuk reseller.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang menyebut masalah spesifik mereka (misalnya selisih stok atau update harga ke reseller), lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.access_note: Trade visitor pre-registration online (free to register).

events.name: KICKFEST REDISCOVER XVII (Kickfest 2026)
events.description: 17th edition of Bandung's long-running local clothing brand festival, combining fashion, local brands, community and music. Organizer is taking registrations for clothing tenants and consignment, so the floor is full of distro/apparel brand owners selling directly.
events.audience: Local brands, creators, communities and young urban visitors
events.crowd: Youth-heavy consumer crowd; the business owners are the clothing/consignment tenants staffing the booths
events.speakers: Music lineup partly announced; tenant count not published
events.why: Dozens of Bandung apparel brand owners in one place, each juggling stock across sizes/colors, consignment and online + booth sales. Inventory, POS and WhatsApp order tools fit them well. Go on Friday morning, before the music crowd arrives, to talk with tenants.
events.verified_note: Date, time, venue, organizer and price confirmed on the loket.com ticket page; dates/venue on the @kickfest.official Instagram bio; tenant clothing and consignment registration forms are on their linktree. Tenant count not published.

prep.who: Owners or co-founders of Bandung distro/clothing brands (often 2–10 staff), running their own booth. Daily pains: stock spread across sizes/colors/outlets, recording booth and consignment sales by hand, reconciling marketplace + WhatsApp + offline orders, chasing reseller payments.
icebreakers: Brand-nya dari Bandung juga? Udah ikut Kickfest dari tahun berapa?
Wah desainnya keren, biasanya paling laku ukuran atau warna apa di sini?
Kalau di event gini, stoknya dibawa dari gudang sendiri atau ada yang titip jual juga?

cost: Selama event tiga hari ini, penjualan dan sisa stok dicatat pakai apa? Nanti dicocokkan ke gudang gimana?
Kalau barang konsinyasi atau reseller, ngitung setoran dan sisa barangnya makan waktu berapa lama?
Pernah nggak kejadian stok di Shopee/IG kelihatan ada, padahal barangnya sudah kejual di booth?
revenue: Pembeli dari event biasanya balik lagi beli online nggak? Datanya disimpan di mana?
Order lewat WhatsApp/DM sekarang dibalas manual semua? Pernah ada order yang kelewat?
Kalau drop koleksi baru, biasanya ngabarin pelanggan lama lewat apa?

prep.one_liner: Saya software engineer di Bandung, bikin aplikasi kasir dan stok buat toko, contohnya Nota Toko yang dipakai toko bahan kue dan plastik buat kasir sama nota. Saya juga bikin otomatisasi WhatsApp buat broadcast dan follow-up pelanggan.
prep.solution: Satu aplikasi stok + kasir sederhana yang dipakai di booth, gudang, dan untuk catat konsinyasi, plus broadcast WhatsApp otomatis ke pembeli lama setiap ada drop baru.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp di booth. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang menyebut brand dan masalah spesifiknya (misal: 'rekap stok konsinyasi manual'), lalu tawarkan lihat gratis 15 menit ke cara mereka catat stok sekarang.

events.name: Manufacturing Indonesia 2026
events.description: Indonesia's largest annual manufacturing exhibition, co-located with Machine Tool, Tools & Hardware, Industrial Automation, Production Logistics, and new for 2026, Fastener and Industrial Paint & Coatings Indonesia. The 2025 edition had 1,300+ exhibitors from 29 countries and 41,000+ trade attendees.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.crowd: Factory owners, plant and production managers, procurement staff, machinery and tool distributors. Large, multi-hall show.
events.speakers: 2025: 1,300+ exhibitors from 29 countries; 2026 count not yet published
events.contact: Farah Alkatiri (Pamerindo) +62 813 1191 6373; contact form on official site
events.why: A huge pool of manufacturing decision-makers in one place. The best targets are local tools, hardware and fastener distributors and small and mid-size workshops that still run stock, quotations and invoicing by hand. Many automation exhibitors sell tech themselves, so walk past them.
events.verified_note: Dates, venue, organizer and registration link confirmed on manufacturingindonesia.com. Daily hours and visitor price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: SME factory owners, workshop owners, production and procurement managers, and local distributors of tools, hardware and fasteners. Their daily pain points are quotations and price lists done in Excel, tracking orders and delivery, stock of thousands of small SKUs, and slow invoicing and collections.
icebreakers: Bapak/Ibu datang untuk cari mesin baru, atau lagi cari supplier?
Dari tadi saya lihat banyak mesin canggih, tapi penasaran juga: urusan administrasi seperti penawaran harga dan invoice di pabrik Bapak/Ibu sudah serapi mesinnya belum?
Bapak/Ibu dari daerah mana? Saya dari Bandung, banyak juga workshop dan konveksi di sana.

cost: Bikin penawaran harga atau quotation ke klien biasanya butuh berapa lama?
Stok sparepart dan bahan baku dicatat di mana, dan seberapa sering datanya tidak cocok dengan barang di gudang?
Berapa orang admin yang mengurus PO, surat jalan, dan invoice?
revenue: Pelanggan baru biasanya menemukan usaha Bapak/Ibu dari mana: website, katalog, atau sales?
Kalau ada buyer menanyakan spesifikasi produk, jawabnya cepat atau harus cari-cari file dulu?
Ada target masuk ke buyer yang lebih besar atau ekspor? Biasanya mereka minta dokumen atau katalog seperti apa?

prep.one_liner: Saya bikin aplikasi bisnis khusus untuk usaha: stok, penawaran harga, nota dan invoice, juga website katalog produk yang cepat dibuka. Di portal properti tempat saya kerja, saya memangkas ukuran halaman dari 2MB jadi 200–400KB.
prep.solution: Sistem sederhana untuk quotation, stok, dan invoice yang terhubung ke WhatsApp, ditambah katalog produk online lengkap dengan spesifikasi supaya buyer bisa cek sendiri.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang mengingatkan obrolan soal masalah mereka (misalnya quotation yang lama atau stok yang tidak cocok), lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.name: APLF ASEAN Indonesia 2026 – M.E.E.T. (Leather & Materials Business Matching)
events.description: A two-day B2B sourcing and business-matching event. It connects international suppliers of hides, wet-blue, finished leather, tanning chemicals and synthetic materials with Indonesian tanneries and footwear/leather-goods manufacturers. Indonesian exhibitors include PT International Leather Works, PT Mastrotto Indonesia, PT Trio Putera Utama and Thoriq–Nogosari Leather.
events.address: Jl. H. Benyamin Sueb, Pademangan Timur, Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat
events.distance: ~3–3.5h from Bandung by car/train (Whoosh to Halim + ~45 min)
events.audience: Indonesian tanneries and leather, footwear and leather-goods manufacturers; ASEAN regional buying offices
events.crowd: Small, focused trade crowd (about 30 listed suppliers). Visitors are production owners, procurement and sourcing managers
events.speakers: About 30 suppliers listed (France, Italy, UAE, Saudi Arabia, China, Ethiopia, Uzbekistan, Indonesia)
events.access_note: Trade visitors; free pre-registration on aplf.com. Business-matching meeting requests are made by stating your sourcing interests before the event.
events.why: Owners and procurement heads of leather and footwear factories, many with Bandung or Garut supply chains (Cibaduyut, Sukaregang). They run stock, orders and costing on spreadsheets. It overlaps Plastics & Rubber Indonesia (17–20 Nov, JIExpo, already shown), so one trip covers both.
events.verified_note: Dates, hours, Hall C1 and free registration confirmed on aplf.com (2026 page, read via headless browser). Some third-party listings say 18–19 Nov; the organizer page says 17–18 Nov.

prep.who: Owners and production/procurement managers of tanneries and shoe/bag factories. Daily pains: tracking hides and leather stock by grade and lot, costing per article, chasing buyer orders and sample approvals, and reconciling supplier invoices in USD.
icebreakers: Bapak/Ibu lagi cari bahan apa hari ini, kulit jadi atau wet-blue?
Pabriknya di mana? Kalau Bandung/Garut saya dekat, saya dari Bandung.
Dari tadi keliling, supplier mana yang paling menarik buat Bapak/Ibu?

cost: Stok kulit per grade dan per lot sekarang dicatat pakai apa, Excel atau buku?
Berapa lama tim admin menghitung HPP per artikel tiap ada order baru?
Pernah ada selisih stok atau kulit yang 'hilang' antara gudang dan produksi?
revenue: Pembeli ekspor biasanya menemukan pabrik Bapak/Ibu dari mana, pameran atau online?
Ada katalog produk online yang bisa langsung dikirim ke buyer luar negeri?
Berapa lama dari buyer minta sampel sampai dapat penawaran harga?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer dari Bandung yang bikin aplikasi bisnis custom: kasir dan nota, stok, invoice. Salah satunya dipakai toko bahan kue dan plastik untuk nota dan stok harian. Saya juga bikin katalog web yang cepat untuk buyer ekspor.
prep.solution: A simple stock-by-lot and costing app (web, works on a phone in the warehouse), plus a fast English product catalog for export buyers.
prep.follow_up: Ask for their WhatsApp number. Within 24h, message them recalling their specific problem (for example 'selisih stok kulit per lot'). Offer a free 15-minute look at how they track it today, by call or at the factory if it is in Bandung.

events.name: IndoBuildTech Expo 2026 (Part 2)
events.worth_reason: Strong exhibitor crowd, but NICE PIK 2 is the farthest venue from Bandung (~3.5–4h each way) and the show is crowded with marketing staff, so it scores just under 70. Worth it if you are already in Jakarta for INTEX (same week).
events.description: Building materials, architecture and interior exhibition (finishing, furniture, lighting, smart home) by Debindo. This is the second 2026 Jabodetabek edition; earlier 2026 editions were Bandung (May) and ICE BSD (July).
events.organizer: PT Debindo International Trade and Exhibitions
events.audience: Buyers, manufacturers, architects, contractors and the public (per organizer: 'key buyers, manufacturers, and visitors')
events.crowd: Building-material and interior brands, furniture manufacturers, distributors, contractors, developers and architects
events.speakers: Exhibitor count for this edition not stated
events.why: It sits where your property-domain knowledge meets manufacturing: furniture and interior makers, material distributors and contractors who need product catalogs, quotation tools and lead follow-up on WhatsApp. Your Rumah123 background gives you credibility with developers and contractors.
events.verified_note: Dates (25–29 Nov 2026), venue NICE PIK 2, organizer and registration link confirmed on indobuildtech.com. Hours and price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: Owners of furniture and interior workshops, building-material distributors, contractors and small developers. Their daily pain points are many enquiries on WhatsApp that never turn into orders, slow manual quotations or RAB, catalogs kept as heavy PDFs, and project and payment tracking.
icebreakers: Booth-nya ramai sekali. Biasanya dari pameran begini, berapa banyak yang benar-benar jadi order?
Saya kerja di portal properti, jadi sering lihat developer kesulitan follow-up leads. Di bisnis interior atau material, masalahnya mirip tidak, Pak/Bu?
Produk ini biasanya lebih banyak dibeli kontraktor atau langsung pemilik rumah?

cost: Bikin penawaran atau RAB untuk satu proyek biasanya butuh berapa lama?
Leads dari pameran dan WhatsApp dicatat di mana? Pernah ada yang lupa di-follow-up?
Progres proyek dan termin pembayaran sekarang dipantau pakai apa?
revenue: Katalog produk dikirim ke calon pembeli dalam bentuk apa: PDF, Instagram, atau website?
Dari semua yang menanyakan harga, kira-kira berapa persen yang akhirnya beli?
Ada rencana menyasar developer perumahan atau proyek yang lebih besar?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer di portal properti dan biasa membuat website katalog yang cepat dibuka serta aplikasi penawaran harga dan follow-up lewat WhatsApp untuk usaha. Tujuannya supaya leads dari pameran tidak hilang begitu saja.
prep.solution: Katalog produk online yang ringan, ditambah alat penawaran harga sederhana dan pengingat follow-up otomatis di WhatsApp untuk setiap lead.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan soal masalah leads atau penawaran yang mereka ceritakan, lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.access_note: Open online registration; trade and public visitors.

events.name: INTEX 2026 – Indonesia International Textile Expo
events.worth_reason: After the Jakarta travel deduction it lands just under 70. Exhibitor origins are not published, and if most booths are overseas suppliers, your prospects (Bandung garment and konveksi owners) are fellow visitors, who are harder to approach than exhibitors. Combine with IndoBuildTech the same week if you go.
events.description: Textile and apparel sourcing show covering fabrics, garments, home textiles, bags and footwear, accessories and trims, and raw materials.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.crowd: Garment makers, konveksi owners, fashion brands and fabric traders. Exhibitor numbers not published (aggregator claims of 10,000+ exhibitors look unreliable).
events.why: Bandung is a garment and konveksi hub, and many of the visitors will be owners from there. Their pain points (order tracking, production status, invoicing resellers) match the apps you build.
events.verified_note: Dates 25–28 Nov 2026, JIExpo Kemayoran and organizer confirmed on intexexpo.com. Hall (C3 per one aggregator), hours, price and exhibitor count not confirmed. Instagram not checked.

events.name: The 12th China Homelife Indonesia Expo 2026 (incl. ABC&MOM)
events.worth_reason: The exhibitors are Chinese suppliers, not clients. The people worth meeting are Indonesian visitors (importers, distributors, retail and shop owners), and they are spread across a 30,000 m² floor. Only worth it combined with INTEX (same venue and dates, already shown) or on a day with the organizer's business-networking slots.
events.format: Expo (B2B sourcing) + matchmaking + business networking sessions
events.description: Meorient's big B2B sourcing fair of Chinese manufacturers: machinery, textile and garment, building materials, household and gifts, electronics, appliances, pet and baby products. The organizer offers free translation, buyer matchmaking and an RFQ service. It is co-located with INTEX and the ABC&MOM baby/kids trade expo.
events.address: Jl. H. Benyamin Sueb, Pademangan Timur, Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat
events.organizer: PT Meorient Exhibition International (China Homelife / TradeChina)
events.audience: Indonesian importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, contractors and online sellers sourcing from China
events.crowd: Organizer claims 1,500 verified exhibitors and 200,000 visitors (marketing figure)
events.speakers: 1,500+ exhibitors claimed (89+ in textile and garment)
events.access_note: Free online pre-registration for trade visitors.
events.why: Importers, distributors and multi-outlet retailers who are scaling up. Inventory, multi-branch POS and order tracking are typical pains. Best at the scheduled 'Business Networking' slots.
events.verified_note: Dates, hours, venue and free pre-registration confirmed on tradechina.com (2026 edition, read via headless browser). Visitor and exhibitor counts are organizer claims. The ABC&MOM date is 24–27 Nov on one listing and 25–28 Nov on another.

prep.who: Owners and buyers at Indonesian import, wholesale and retail businesses (household goods, building materials, garments, baby products). Daily pains: stock across warehouses and outlets, landed-cost calculation, reseller orders arriving over WhatsApp, and slow-moving stock.
icebreakers: Lagi cari produk kategori apa, Pak/Bu? Buat toko sendiri atau distribusi?
Biasanya impor sendiri atau lewat agen? Ribet nggak urusan dokumennya?
Dari tadi ada supplier yang cocok harganya?

cost: Stok di gudang dan di toko sekarang dicek pakai apa? Sering beda nggak?
Menghitung harga modal sampai barang tiba (ongkir, bea) masih manual?
Order dari reseller masuk lewat WhatsApp lalu dicatat ulang oleh admin?
revenue: Reseller atau pelanggan bisa lihat katalog dan stok terbaru tanpa tanya admin?
Ada pengingat otomatis ke pelanggan lama kalau barang baru datang?
Produk mana yang paling sering kehabisan stok saat ramai?

prep.one_liner: Saya bikin aplikasi kasir, stok dan invoice custom untuk toko dan distributor, plus otomatisasi WhatsApp: pengingat dan broadcast terjadwal ke pelanggan. Contohnya Nota Toko untuk toko bahan kue dan plastik.
prep.solution: A shared stock + order app with an online catalog for resellers and scheduled WhatsApp messages for new-arrival and restock alerts.
prep.follow_up: Ask for their WhatsApp number. Within 24h, message them about the exact problem they named (for example 'stok gudang vs toko beda'). Offer a free 15-minute look at their current spreadsheet or flow.

events.name: Pertamina SMEXPO 2026 (national exhibition)
events.worth_reason: Only 14–15 Nov are left (today and tomorrow), so it means a last-minute ~3h trip each way. Small show (40 booths) in a mall atrium with mostly public shoppers. Note the program for next year instead.
events.format: Expo / bazaar with B2B business matching
events.description: Pertamina's national showcase for its fostered UMKM, themed 'Lokal Jadi Vokal'. 52 UMKM were selected from ~600 applicants: 40 with booths, the rest on consignment. The target is Rp34 billion in B2B transactions with corporate buyers.
events.crowd: 40 UMKM booths (food, fashion, craft) with owners on site, plus mall visitors
events.speakers: Temmy Satya Permana (Kementerian UMKM), Tony Andrianto (Danantara) at opening
events.why: The booths are staffed by owners of curated, growth-stage UMKM who are already selling B2B, a good audience for order, stock and catalog tools. The time left is the problem.
events.verified_note: Dates and venue confirmed by 11 Nov 2026 news reports (RMOL, journalarta). No official Pertamina event page found. Hours, entry price and contact not confirmed. Instagram not checked.

events.name: Pekan Kebudayaan Bandung 2026 X Kreativerse

events.venue: Jl. Dr. Ir. Sukarno & Cikapundung Riverspot
events.address: Jl. Dr. Ir. Sukarno (Braga area) and Cikapundung Riverspot, Bandung

Pesanan lewat WhatsApp sekarang dibalas sendiri? Sering kewalahan di jam ramai?

prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp, lalu dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang menyebut produknya dan masalah yang dia ceritakan. Tawarkan lihat gratis 15 menit ke cara catat penjualan atau order mereka sekarang.

events.name: Jakarta Coffee Week 2026 (Jacoweek)
events.worth_reason: Mostly a consumer festival. The targets are the exhibiting cafe, roastery and equipment owners, not the visitors. ICE BSD is ~3h each way. Worth it only if you want café/F&B owners specifically, best on Friday 4 Dec when booths are quieter.
events.format: Festival / trade show with booths, competitions, cupping area, 'Pasar Kopi' market
events.description: Indonesia's coffee community event, held since 2016. It brings together roasters, coffee shops, tea and chocolate brands, and machine and equipment distributors, with barista and roasting competitions, a cupping area and a coffee market.
events.address: Jl. BSD Grand Boulevard No. 1, BSD City, Tangerang, Banten
events.distance: ~3h from Bandung by car via Tol JORR/Serpong
events.audience: Coffee lovers, baristas, cafe owners, roasters, F&B brands
events.crowd: Large consumer crowd. Exhibitors are coffee shops, roasteries, farmers and producers, and equipment distributors
events.price: Rp 65.000/day (Rp 35.000/day or Rp 100.000 for 3 days with Bank Mandiri)
events.why: Many owner-operated cafes and roasteries in one hall. Their pains (POS, bean and milk stock, wholesale orders over WhatsApp, repeat customers) match Nota Toko and WA Scheduler directly.
events.verified_note: Dates, hours, halls and ticket prices confirmed on the ICE BSD 2026 listing; dates and halls also on jakartacoffeeweek.com. Instagram not opened.

prep.who: Owners of independent cafes and roasteries, and coffee equipment distributors. Daily pains: green-bean and milk stock, wastage, cashier shift reconciliation, wholesale bean orders coming in over WhatsApp, and getting customers to come back.
icebreakers: Ini roastery sendiri, Mas/Mbak? Kafenya di mana?
Beans yang paling laku di booth hari ini yang mana?
Selain di kafe, jual beans wholesale ke kafe lain juga?

cost: Stok green bean dan susu dicatat pakai apa? Sering kaget tiba-tiba habis?
Tutup kasir tiap shift cocok terus, atau sering ada selisih?
Order wholesale dari kafe lain masuk lewat WA lalu dibuatkan nota manual?
revenue: Pelanggan tetap dihubungi lagi lewat apa kalau ada beans atau menu baru?
Ada katalog online untuk pembeli wholesale?
Berapa persen penjualan dari pelanggan yang datang lagi?

prep.one_liner: Saya bikin aplikasi kasir dan nota custom untuk toko, misalnya Nota Toko untuk toko bahan kue dan plastik, dan otomatisasi WhatsApp terjadwal untuk pengingat dan promo ke pelanggan.
prep.solution: A light POS with stock deduction per recipe, a wholesale order and invoice page, and scheduled WhatsApp messages to regulars.
prep.follow_up: Ask for their WhatsApp number (or their Instagram, then WA). Within 24h, message them about the pain they mentioned (for example 'stok susu sering habis'). Offer a free 15-minute look; if they're in Bandung, offer to visit.

events.name: KS Fun Run 2026 + UMKM Fest
events.format: Fun run (5K) with UMKM Fest bazaar
events.description: 5K community fun run organized around BPR KS with an UMKM Fest for local businesses. Mainly a marketing/consumer event, not business matching.
events.address: Kiara Artha Park, Jl. Banten, Bandung
events.audience: Runners/general public; local UMKM as bazaar tenants
events.crowd: Runners and families; UMKM tenants, possibly the BPR's own debtor/partner businesses and bank staff
events.access_note: Run registration said to be online via the BPR KS community page with limited quota; UMKM Fest visitors likely free. Not confirmed.

links.label: News (Pikiran Rakyat PRFM, blocked by bot check)

events.why: UMKM tenants backed by a local BPR, plus BPR staff who are natural referrers (they know which debtors are growing). Small and casual, so expect few contacts.
events.verified_note: Only seen in a search snippet of the PRFM/Pikiran Rakyat article (12 Dec 2026, Kiara Artha Park, UMKM Fest, online registration via BPR KS community page). The article page was blocked by a bot check; no organizer page, ticket page or Instagram post found. Price, time and full organizer name unconfirmed.

prep.who: Local UMKM tenants (food, drinks, sports/fashion goods), some likely BPR debtors, plus BPR relationship/marketing staff. Pains: cash flow, manual bookkeeping for loan reporting, few repeat customers.
icebreakers: Ikut larinya juga atau fokus jualan hari ini?
Kenal sama BPR-nya dari mana? Sudah lama jadi mitra?
Event lari gini biasanya ramai pembeli nggak buat UMKM?

cost: Pembukuan usaha sekarang dikerjakan sendiri? Repot nggak waktu harus laporan ke bank?
Stok dan penjualan harian dicatat di mana?
Berapa jam seminggu habis buat urusan admin dan nota?
revenue: Pelanggan tetap biasanya pesan lewat mana?
Pernah coba promo ke pelanggan lama lewat WhatsApp?
Kalau ada katalog online, kira-kira bisa nambah pesanan nggak?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer di Bandung yang bikin aplikasi kasir, nota dan pembukuan sederhana untuk UMKM, contohnya Nota Toko dan aplikasi invoice/keuangan, supaya catatan usaha rapi dan gampang dilaporkan.
prep.solution: Pembukuan + nota digital sederhana yang bisa langsung diekspor jadi laporan rapi untuk bank, plus WhatsApp otomatis untuk pelanggan tetap.
prep.follow_up: Ambil nomor WhatsApp (juga dari staf BPR sebagai referrer). Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang menyebut masalah yang dia ceritakan, tawarkan lihat gratis 15 menit.

events.name: Indonesia Supply Chain 2026 (with LogiSYM Indonesia)
events.worth_reason: NICE PIK 2 is the farthest venue (~4h from Bandung). The show leans tech-heavy (warehouse automation, robotics, AI/IoT), so many solution vendors and engineers attend and you would not stand out. Visitor price not stated.
events.description: First edition of a logistics and supply-chain exhibition by Hannover Fairs (Deutsche Messe), co-produced with Debindo and powered by CeMAT and LogiSYM, covering warehousing, freight, cold chain, e-commerce logistics and automation.
events.address: Jl. M.H. Thamrin, Salembaran, Kosambi, Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten 15214
events.audience: Decision-makers in logistics, warehousing, freight, manufacturing, e-commerce and retail logistics, government
events.crowd: First edition; exhibitor list still 'coming soon'
events.access_note: Online visitor registration; a separate LogiSYM conference pass exists.
events.why: Ops and logistics managers at manufacturers and distributors, who are referrers for internal tools. Weak for SME owners.
events.verified_note: Dates and venue confirmed on indosupplychain.com. Visitor price not stated (one aggregator says free entry). Hours from an aggregator only. The registration page did not render in the headless browser.

events.name: Webinar UMKM Go Ekspor: Strategi UMKM Menembus Pasar Ekspor (Sesi 1 / Sesi 2)
events.worth_reason: A paid one-way webinar used to sell the organizer's mentoring class. Attendees are mostly aspiring exporters, some without a product yet, and the only way to reach them is the chat. Online events are never top-ranked. Join only if an evening slot is free, and use the chat to spot active exporters.
events.description: A 2-hour evening webinar by the UMKM Go Ekspor community (speaker Roy Wibisono) on how UMKM can get into export markets. Both sessions cover the same material; Sesi 2 runs on 4 Dec 2026, also at 19:00 WIB. It funnels into a paid mentoring and community membership that covers product research, buyer access and forwarding.
events.organizer: Komunitas UMKM Go Ekspor (Roy Wibisono & tim)
events.audience: UMKM that want to export, including people with no product yet
events.crowd: Not stated. Expect a mix of small producers and would-be exporters, plus some resellers and beginners.
events.price: Rp 100.000 promo for the first 30 registrants (normal Rp 500.000)
events.why: The attendees are export-minded UMKM who will need an export-ready product catalog/website, invoicing and buyer follow-up, which matches the profile. But the format gives little real interaction, so contacts come only from active chat participants.
events.verified_note: Dates, times and price confirmed on umkmgoekspor.com/webinar (2026 page). The order page for Sesi 1 shows 'Stok Produk Kosong' and lists no date, so registration may be closed or full; confirm by WA. Platform not stated. No Instagram post checked.

prep.who: Small producers (food, craft, furniture, fashion) and resellers who want their first export buyer. Daily pains: no English catalog or website buyers trust, quotes and proforma invoices done by hand in Excel/WA, slow follow-up with overseas inquiries, and no idea of their real per-unit cost.
icebreakers: Halo, produknya apa? Sudah pernah kirim sampel ke buyer luar?
Tadi poin soal buyer minta katalog itu relate banget ya, Bapak/Ibu sekarang kirim katalog lewat apa?
Ikut webinar ini karena sudah ada inquiry dari luar, atau baru mulai riset?

cost: Kalau ada inquiry dari buyer, bikin penawaran dan proforma invoice-nya masih manual di Excel atau Word?
Hitung HPP per unit sampai harga FOB itu sekarang pakai apa, ada yang pernah salah hitung?
Stok bahan dan pesanan dicatat di mana? Pernah kejadian pesanan dobel atau stok kurang?
revenue: Buyer luar biasanya nemu Bapak/Ibu dari mana: marketplace B2B, Instagram, atau website sendiri?
Sudah punya website atau katalog berbahasa Inggris yang bisa dibuka cepat di HP buyer?
Berapa banyak inquiry yang akhirnya tidak di-follow up karena sibuk produksi?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer software di Bandung. Saya bikinkan katalog/website ekspor yang cepat dan muncul di Google (di Rumah123 saya kecilkan halaman dari 2MB ke 200-an KB), plus aplikasi nota dan invoice sederhana seperti yang saya buat untuk toko bahan kue.
prep.solution: A lightweight English product catalog site with an inquiry form and WhatsApp follow-up reminders, plus a simple quote/proforma-invoice app.
prep.follow_up: Ask for their WhatsApp in the chat or a DM. Within 24h, message them with the problem they described (e.g. 'katalog belum ada' or 'invoice masih manual') and offer a free 15-minute look at their current catalog or invoicing flow.

events.name: 11th Expo Clean & Expo Laundry 2026
events.worth_reason: Today (14 Nov) is the last day, so it is too late to plan a ~3h trip. The audience is a great fit (laundry and cleaning-service owners), so note it for the November 2027 edition.
events.description: Regional trade show for cleaning and textile care: laundry machines, chemicals, and cleaning equipment. Visitors are commercial laundry owners and hotel, hospital and facility-management operators.
events.address: Jl. BSD Grand Boulevard No. 1, BSD City, Tangerang, Banten
events.audience: Laundry business owners, hotel/hospital laundry managers, cleaning service and facility-management companies, distributors
events.why: Laundry owners need order tracking, nota, WhatsApp 'cucian sudah siap' notifications and branch reporting, which fits Nota Toko and WA Scheduler exactly.
events.verified_note: Dates, hours and venue confirmed on expo-clean.com and the ICE BSD listing. Visitor price not stated.

events.name: PropVaganza 2026 by Rumah123 – Central Park
events.worth_reason: Consumer property fair in a mall atrium. Exhibitors are mostly developers' marketing staff, not owners, and the 2026 dates are unconfirmed. It is also your employer's own event, so it is not a neutral place to pitch side work.
events.description: Rumah123's annual series of property fairs in malls, with developer promos, KPR consultations and talkshows. A May 2026 report lists a December stop at Central Park.
events.crowd: Public home seekers and developer sales teams
events.why: Low client potential. Listed only for completeness in the property category.
events.verified_note: Only the month (December 2026) comes from a May 2026 news article. rumah123.com/events shows only the 2025 Central Park edition (2–7 Dec 2025) and '2027 coming soon'. 2026 dates are unconfirmed and may fall outside the window.

events.name: Indonesia Maternity, Baby & Kids Expo (IMBEX) 2026
events.worth_reason: A consumer shopping expo. Exhibitors are baby and kids brands (some UMKM), but booths are busy selling to parents. Low decision-maker density for the trip cost, and details are unverified.
events.description: Retail expo of maternity, baby and kids products, with brand booths and family activities.
events.address: Jl. Gatot Subroto, Senayan, Jakarta Pusat
events.audience: Parents and families; exhibitors are baby/kids product brands
events.why: Small baby-product brands sell online and offline and could use catalog, stock and WhatsApp tools, but this is a weak room for conversations.
events.verified_note: Dates (27–29 Nov) and venue are from aggregator listings only. Listings disagree on venue (JICC vs JCC) and organizer (Reed Panorama / RX). No official 2026 page found.
